summary: For iid Uniform[0,1] and the spectral split Q3=((X1+X4)/sqrt2)^2+X2^2-X3^2, Q'=((X1-X4)/sqrt2)^2, the full Q is the diagonal target X1^2+X2^2-X3^2+X4^2 and has density <=pi, but ess sup_b ||p_(Q3|Q'=b)||_infinity=infinity. As b approaches 1/2, the conditional Y=(X1+X4)/sqrt2 interval has length L=sqrt2-2sqrt(b), and p_(Q3|b)(1/2)>=(1/4)(log(1/(2L))+1). Thus the revision-11 unweighted scalar-conditioning supremum is not a universal proof interface. The exact mixture identity survives; a repaired sufficient target is the weighted mixed norm int sup_s p_(Q3,Q')(s,b) db = E ||p_(Q3|Q')||_infinity.
continuity_relevance: none; correction concerns only an intermediate conditioning interface
